purpose: Add deterministic translation-only center-to-center distance joints around the preserved AXM Physics Core without pretending that angular anchors or a full rigid-joint system already exist.

properties.joints: bounded array of center-to-center distance constraints

contains: imported core collision and integration evidence

relationships.basis: This capability projects a target center distance and constrains relative axis velocity; the existing spring path remains intentionally soft and force-based.

limitations: no angular inertia or angular response
no hinge, slider, weld, motor or gear constraints
connected-body collision suppression is not implemented
constraint projection occurs before the imported core collision/integration step, so forces can create bounded distance error until the next solve
persistent_state: joint definitions are explicit caller-owned JSON data

proves: truthful handling of two immovable bodies

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly translation-only and distinguishes projected distance joints from soft springs and from unsupported angular joint families.

agency.basis: Joint endpoints, length, correction bounds and solver iteration counts remain caller-controlled explicit data.

continuity.basis: The donor physics core remains byte-for-byte preserved; this is an additive layer exposed through the same physics capsule.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The first rigid-constraint step is deliberately bounded to one auditable joint family before attempting rotation, anchored joints or larger constraint systems.
